claim_boundary: This audit tests whether the pyramid materializes A6 sufficiently to define a finite realization transport. It does not infer an operator from semantic labels.

required_a6_slots.acceptance_test: path or graph id defining the A6 carrier and coefficient object
typed domain and codomain of K_global
ordered basis retaining prime, grade, shell, pair orientation, endpoint and response jets
exact K_global matrix on the finite p=2, J=2 basis
restriction of the retained Fourier-Poisson sewing to the same finite basis
source form J_A6 against which T_real can be tested
one completion theorem on the declared A6 carrier, not distributed compatibility claims

disposition.reopening_condition: materialize the A6 carrier, then its finite p=2, J=2 basis and K_global matrix
